LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hoplon.label: hoplon display
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hoplon.description: A great bronze-faced round shield painted with the owl of the league, hung where guests can admire it.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Column.label: hero column
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Column.description: A fluted marble column crowned with the bronze statue of a hero. Every city in Hellas has a forest of them.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Stage.label: theatre stage
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Stage.description: A raised wooden stage before a painted backdrop of columns, with the masks of comedy and tragedy above. Colonists gather in front of it to watch and to perform.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lyceum.label: lyceum scroll cabinet
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lyceum.description: A cedar cabinet full of scrolls with a marble bust of a philosopher on top. Placed near a research bench, it speeds up research by 6%.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Asclepion.label: asclepion
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Asclepion.description: A small marble altar to the healer god, with herbs smouldering in a bronze bowl and the snake-wound rod beside it. Beds within six cells get +4% tend quality and +3% immunity gain speed.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos_Gun.label: throwing arm
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos_Gun.description: The turning top of the lithobolos.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos.label: lithobolos
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos.description: A torsion stone thrower on a marble platform. Its arm hurls a stone the size of a head that breaks bones and shields alike. It cannot hit anything closer than six cells and is slow, but it reaches very far. Feed it stone chunks: one chunk makes ten stones.
